lemmas.primary_translation: to compensate for / to pay / in sports: to stay close to an opposing player in order to prevent them from getting the ball or the like

definitions.text: i idrett: holde seg nær en motspiller for å hindre denne i å få ballen eller lignende
definitions.translation: in sports: to stay close to an opposing player in order to prevent them from getting the ball or the like

examples.no: han var flink til å dekke opp spillerne på det andre laget
examples.en: he was good at marking the players on the other team
